description: Primary insurance amount from the bend point formula (1286 and 7749) applied to average indexed monthly earnings, with monthly benefits at ages 62, 67, and 70. Annual earnings, when given above 0, override AIME as annual divided by 12. Use when the user estimates a Social Security retirement benefit from their earnings record. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive social security estimator calculator.

aime_monthly.description: Average indexed monthly earnings in USD.

annual_earnings.description: Annual earnings in USD; when above 0 it overrides aime_monthly. Default 0.
